name: ocg-public-website-rebuild
description: PHP website rebuild for Oro-Construction Group (OCG)

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:admin:css && npm run build:admin:js
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:admin
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --names API,PHP --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test:php: for file in *.php includes/*.php admin/*.php; do php -l "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:php && npm run test:backend
